subject: ela
cluster: Range of Reading and Level of Text Complexity
intro: Read each informational passage and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

The heart's four chambers pump blood.

How many chambers?
A) Two
B) Four
C) Six

Read.

The author urges cities to plant more trees.

Purpose:
A) persuade
B) entertain
C) confuse

'As a scientist of 30 years, I assure you...' appeals to:
A) ethos (credibility)
B) pathos only
C) rhyme

Read.

The Industrial Revolution created wealth and technology but also brutal conditions and inequality.

The central idea is that it:
A) had only benefits
B) brought both great progress and serious harms
C) had no effect
items.answer: B) brought both great progress and serious harms

solution.answer: B) brought both great progress and serious harms

items.prompt:
'We must act now, for tomorrow may be too late' creates a sense of:
A) urgency, urging immediate action
B) calm
C) humor

steps: Call to act. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The printing press made books cheaper and spread literacy.

An effect was:
A) fewer readers
B) more literacy
C) no change

Read.

'Everyone is switching to this plan, so you should too.'

This reasoning is weak because it is a:
A) bandwagon appeal (popularity isn't proof)
B) valid statistic
C) relevant study

Read.

Coral reefs cover under 1% of the ocean floor yet support about a quarter of marine species; as seas warm, many are dying.

Which is BEST supported?
A) Protecting reefs protects a large share of ocean life
B) Reefs are unimportant
C) All sea life lives on land
items.answer: A) Protecting reefs protects a large share of ocean life

solution.answer: A) Protecting reefs protects a large share of ocean life
